\section*{Greenhouse trial}
All four greenhouses grew faster than the field plots.

\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{llrrr}
House & Crop & Temp (C) & Growth (cm) & Gain (\%) \\
East & Basil & 24.5 & 31.2 & 18.4 \\
West & Tomato & 22.1 & 48.9 & 12.7 \\
North & Pepper & 23.8 & 27.4 & 15.9 \\
South & Lettuce & 19.6 & 22.3 & 9.8 \\
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

The team will plant a fifth house in March.
